name: ChatGPT Plus

catalogGuideSteps.title: 설정 메뉴 열기
catalogGuideSteps.description: 화면 좌측 하단 프로필 아이콘 클릭 후 [Settings] 메뉴를 누르세요.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 구독 관리 진입
catalogGuideSteps.description: [Subscription] 탭에서 [Manage]를 클릭하여 Stripe 결제창으로 이동합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 플랜 취소
catalogGuideSteps.description: 결제 관리 화면에서 [플랜 취소(Cancel plan)]를 누르고 취소를 확정합니다.

catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide lists going to [Subscription] tab > [Manage] to open Stripe portal and clicking [Cancel plan]. Current official documentation states: Open account menu > Settings > Billing > under Cancel plan, select Cancel (or Manage subscription for business).
notes: Official doc covers web (chatgpt.com), Apple App Store, Google Play, and ChatGPT Business. Web cancellation is done in account menu > Settings > Billing > Cancel.

name: Claude Pro

catalogGuideSteps.title: 설정 메뉴 진입
catalogGuideSteps.description: 좌측 하단 내 계정 이름/프로필 클릭 후 [Settings]를 선택합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 청구 탭 이동
catalogGuideSteps.description: 좌측 설정 사이드바에서 [Billing] 메뉴를 클릭합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 구독 취소
catalogGuideSteps.description: Claude Pro 섹션에서 [Cancel Subscription]을 누르고 확인합니다.

steps.label: Initials or name (lower left corner) > Settings

catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide lists [Cancel Subscription], but official doc explicitly specifies clicking the “Cancel” button under Settings > Billing.
notes: Official help article was updated in Oct 2026 covering Pro and Max plans. Web/desktop subscriptions are canceled via web settings; mobile subscriptions (iOS/Android) must be cancelled in app store.

name: Perplexity Pro

catalogGuideSteps.title: 설정 메뉴
catalogGuideSteps.description: 좌측 사이드바 하단 톱니바퀴 [Settings] 아이콘을 누릅니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 계정 탭 확인
catalogGuideSteps.description: [Account] 탭에서 Perplexity Pro 멤버십 상태를 확인합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 구독 취소
catalogGuideSteps.description: 요금제 우측 [Cancel Subscription] 버튼을 클릭하여 해지합니다.

steps.label: Scroll to Subscription under Perplexity Pro

catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide states clicking [Cancel Subscription] directly to the right of the plan in the [Account] tab. The official help center doc indicates going to Settings > scroll to "Subscription" under Perplexity Pro > click "Manage Subscription" to be redirected to the current plan page, then choose "Cancel subscription."
notes: Official Help Center article at help-center/en/articles/10354283-canceling-a-subscription. Covers web, iOS (App Store), and Android (Google Play). Note: Deleting account does not terminate subscription; cancellation takes effect at cycle end.

name: Midjourney

catalogGuideSteps.title: 계정 페이지 접속
catalogGuideSteps.description: Midjourney 공식 사이트(midjourney.com/account)에 로그인합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 구독 관리 열기
catalogGuideSteps.description: 화면의 [Manage Sub] 버튼을 클릭해 결제 포털로 이동합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 플랜 취소 확정
catalogGuideSteps.description: [Billing & Cancellation]에서 [Cancel Plan]을 누르고 주기 만료 취소를 선택합니다.

steps.label: Confirm cancellation (or Cancel at end of cycle / Refund if <20 GPU min)

retention: Option to refund immediately if <20 lifetime GPU minutes used, otherwise cancellation effective at end of current billing cycle with access preserved
catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide lists navigating to midjourney.com/account, clicking [Manage Sub] button to open billing portal, and selecting [Billing & Cancellation] > [Cancel Plan]. Official documentation shows the button on the Manage Subscription page is directly labeled [Cancel Plan] (with [Edit Billing], [View Invoices], [Change Plan]), and note: if an upgrade/downgrade was scheduled, user must use [Cancel Change] first.
notes: Official Help Center articles (Zendesk-based at docs.midjourney.com/hc/en-us). Login methods are Discord and Google OAuth. Cancellation takes effect at billing cycle end with private images remaining private.

name: Runway Gen-4.5

catalogGuideSteps.title: 설정 진입
catalogGuideSteps.description: Runway 우측 상단 프로필 아이콘 클릭 후 [Settings]로 들어갑니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 요금제 탭 선택
catalogGuideSteps.description: 좌측 메뉴에서 [Plans & Billing]을 선택합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 구독 해지
catalogGuideSteps.description: 이용 중인 플랜 카드 우측 [Manage Plan] > [Cancel Subscription]을 누릅니다.

steps.label: Select cancellation reason > Continue to cancel plan

retention: Get 1 month free offer ("Get a free month" vs "Continue to cancel plan")
notes: Verified directly from Runway client code bundle and Terms of Use. Subscription flow includes a retention modal offering "Get 1 month free" followed by a 2-step Cancellation Survey before the final "Cancel Plan" button.

name: v0 by Vercel

catalogGuideSteps.title: 계정/청구 진입
catalogGuideSteps.description: v0 우측 상단 프로필 > [Settings] > [Billing] 메뉴로 이동합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 구독 항목 선택
catalogGuideSteps.description: 이용 중인 v0 Premium 또는 Vercel 구독 항목을 확인합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 구독 취소
catalogGuideSteps.description: [Cancel Subscription]을 클릭하여 차기 결제를 취소합니다.

catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide lists button label as [Cancel Subscription], but official v0 Pricing FAQ explicitly states clicking "Cancel Plan" under Plan Summary on the v0 Billing Page (https://v0.app/chat/settings/billing).
notes: Official FAQ from v0.dev/pricing (#06 How do I cancel my plan?): "If you are on the v0 Free, Premium, Plus, or Business plan, follow the steps below to cancel your plan: 1. Navigate to v0 Billing Page (https://v0.app/chat/settings/billing) 2. Under Plan Summary, click Cancel Plan."

name: Figma Professional

catalogGuideSteps.title: 설정 메뉴 진입
catalogGuideSteps.description: Figma 좌측 상단 프로필 드롭다운을 누르고 [Settings]를 선택합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 청구 탭 이동
catalogGuideSteps.description: [Billing] 탭 또는 관리자 워크스페이스 플랜 영역으로 이동합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 플랜 취소
catalogGuideSteps.description: Professional 플랜 우측 [Cancel plan]을 누르고 다운그레이드를 확인합니다.

retention: Downgrade to free Starter plan with file/folder limitations
catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide says to click top-left profile dropdown > [Settings] > [Billing] > [Cancel plan]. However, Figma Professional plans are scoped to teams: the user must locate the Professional team in the file browser sidebar, click [Admin], select the [Settings] tab, and click [Cancel plan] in the Plan section.
notes: Official documentation explicitly outlines steps for Professional team cancellation: Admin > Settings tab > Plan > Cancel plan > select reason > Cancel plan. At billing period end, team downgrades to free Starter plan.
